dreamteamer.title: Meetings
dreamteamer.description: Every calendar `meeting` (synced from Google Calendar, direct to the API) and the three artifacts a call produces: the ten-minute `meeting-preps` read before it, the neutral `meeting-summaries` record of it, and the `meeting-analyses` critique built on the transcript. Attendees are `contacts`, follow-ups are `tasks` and the people of ours in the room are `users` (`ours`), both from the `projects` module; the audio and transcript live in the `recordings` module, which depends on this one and stamps `meetings.recordings` onto it when installed — so a workspace that never records still syncs, preps and summarises from notes.
